faq_heading: Homes near James Kennedy Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the James Kennedy Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Langley School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the James Kennedy Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names James Kennedy Elementary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: How much do homes near James Kennedy Elementary sell for?
faq.a: Within 1 km of the school, 147 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,265,000, townhomes $775,000, condos $575,000. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near James Kennedy Elementary?
faq.a: Within 1 km of James Kennedy Elementary the median was 23 days on the market, closing at 97.7% of the list price, with 5% of sales above the list price for the 147 homes within 1 km.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to James Kennedy Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Topham Elementary (0.6 km east), Walnut Grove Secondary (0.6 km west) and West Langley Elementary (0.9 km north).

James Kennedy Elementary is an elementary school in Langley (Langley School District), at 9060 212 St. It teaches grades K to 7. Programs listed: Early French Immersion.
The search below lists homes for sale whose listing names James Kennedy Elementary. Under it are the prices homes sold for within 1 km of the school.
How the James Kennedy Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names James Kennedy Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 1 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 1 km of James Kennedy Elementary sold for
Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 147 homes sold within 1 km of James Kennedy Elementary: 57 houses, 85 townhomes and 5 condos. The largest group was townhomes, at a median of $775,000.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of James Kennedy Elementary

14 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of James Kennedy Elementary in a straight line (11 elementary, 1 secondary, 1 middle, 1 other; 1 independent). The closest is Topham Elementary, 0.6 km away, and the farthest on this list is Donna Gabriel Robins Elementary, 2.8 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is Walnut Grove Secondary (0.6 km); the nearest independent school is The King's School (2.7 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Walnut Grove Secondary (0.6 km). Other elementary schools close by: Topham Elementary (0.6 km east), West Langley Elementary (0.9 km north), des Voyageurs (1.0 km south-east), Alex Hope Elementary (1.2 km south), Gordon Greenwood Elementary (1.4 km west). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is Topham Elementary, 0.6 km east of James Kennedy Elementary.

Visit on a school day at drop-off and pick-up. Traffic and parking near James Kennedy Elementary are very different at 8:30 am and 3 pm than on a Sunday viewing.

Compare price with similar homes farther from the school. The median townhome within 1 km of James Kennedy Elementary was $775,000, so check whether size and age explain a gap before you pay for the location.
